review_metadata.question: Whether any of the 21 fixed dev3 RotateLeft32Bits(3) bug_found candidates qualifies as a reviewed original-component defect.

component_scope.project_context_boundary: This review covers the pinned L=3 original component only. The inspected ChaCha20 build uses L=16,12,8,7 and has no identified L=3 instantiation, so no ChaCha20 project defect is claimed.

preservation_and_execution_link_checks: candidate file SHA-256 equals the fixed selection entry
outcome counterexample artifact matches candidate path, SHA-256, run, target, and classification
scheduler run matches run and target and has backend status bug_found
outcome plan hash and ID match, and its target is RotateLeft32Bits(3) over bn128
plan snapshot fingerprints match the previously reviewed wrapper and template source

criteria.input_preconditions: Direct range check against the predeclared unsigned 32-bit domain.
criteria.fixed_original_constraints: Direct finite-field evaluation of every row in the pinned, hash-verified original R1CS using the preserved assignment; no witness generation.
criteria.specified_property_violation: Compared with the predeclared rotate-left property only when the input precondition is satisfied.

review_method.overall_rule: valid requires verified run/target linkage and all three criteria satisfied; any definitely not-satisfied criterion rejects the exact candidate; unresolved linkage or criteria remain unknown.
review_method.schema_2_rule: Only valid candidates may appear in top-level confirmations; repeated candidates for the same root cause are deduplicated to the earliest scheduler completion upper bound.

summary.common_rejection_reason: All candidates violate the unsigned 32-bit input precondition; all satisfy both pinned-original constraints, and the domain-limited rotation property is therefore unknown rather than treated as passed or failed.
